findings.evidence: Form shows email input with type='email' and a Save button. Separately, a Continue link points to invite-sent. The artifact does not specify what happens after clicking Save: whether the form validates, submits to a server, shows an error or confirmation, or what state the user enters.
findings.fix: Specify the next state after Save is clicked: either a confirmation or result screen within the artifact itself, or in-place validation feedback showing success or error.
findings.location: invite-member section, Save button in email form
findings.violation: The artifact specifies the Save action but does not specify visible feedback (in-progress indicator, validation result, or confirmation) for what happens when the user submits the email form.

findings.evidence: Form shows input with value='Q3 Roadmap' and a Save button, but the artifact does not specify what the user sees after clicking Save: no loading state, success message, error message, or page reload shown.
findings.fix: Add specification of what happens after Save: either show the artifact reaching a next screen that the spec defines, or specify an in-place success message or confirmation state.
findings.location: project-settings section, Save button in project name form
findings.violation: The artifact specifies the Save action but does not specify visible feedback (in-progress indicator, result message, or changed control state) for what happens after the user clicks it.

findings.evidence: Select element shows three options: Daily, Weekly, Monthly. No option element carries a 'selected' attribute, so the artifact does not indicate which frequency is the current setting.
findings.fix: Add a 'selected' attribute to one of the three options to indicate the current digest frequency setting, or add explanatory text above the select stating the current value.
findings.location: notification-settings section, digest frequency select dropdown
findings.violation: At the notification-settings step, the user needs to know their current digest frequency in order to decide whether to change it. The form does not show which option is currently selected.
